color_value_format: Exact runtime value from upstream rgb(hex): rgb(R,G,B), or empty string; hex preserves the source literal
color_sha256_scope: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 color value (for example rgb(125,161,222)); an empty color hashes the empty byte string
palette_sha256_scope: SHA-256 of compact JSON mapping the 81 Theme keys, in Theme declaration order, to color values
